author: Scout
change_details: Keep verified small forecast routing records between scoring passes instead of repeatedly decoding historical full model payloads.
Reload and validate the immutable original before appending any outcome or synthetic audit revision.
Retain pending historical retries, exact target/source qualification, new forecasts, corrections and saved forecast policies.
Preserve prior private scoring deduplication, local model recipes and human trader controls.
limitations: The first scoring poll validates every scoped forecast once; unchanged polls validate indexed routing identities, not all historical payload bytes. Selected complete originals and routing equality are validated immediately before outcome observation or legacy invalidation.
The cache retains only serialized routing projections, bounded to4096entries and16MiB; overflow entries are safely reread instead of cached. It retains no model list or full dataset manifest.
Historical missing inputs remain exact-source unresolved targets and retain retry behavior. No target shifting, support relaxation, model recipe change or expired decision replay.

Offline checks establish read avoidance and scoring/correction/integrity semantics, not actual full-cycle or concurrent-thread latency recovery. Root must retain installed private scoring-dedup behavior and run combined-runtime checks.
Only the3owned isolatedworktree paths changed. No canonical/runtime/recipe/config/tradingstate or tradercontrols changed by author.
Counts from author, queue, candidate and local runtime stages overlap.
Scoped scoring reads do not perform an all-history corruption audit on every poll; selected outcome mutations require the original verified forecast.
Offline checks do not establish runtime reload, recovered exact-source gaps or full-cycle latency recovery.
Main preparation is blocked until the reviewed parent source is integrated. Resume the same Completion-Record.
Private account state, credentials, raw data, fitted models, local recipe identities and operating logs are excluded.

main_integration.reason: origin/main does not descend from reviewed source base

peer_applicability: Shared scoring processing repair applies to either PC. Keep private recipes, symbols, data and operating bindings local. Peer installation is not established.
runtime_implications: Scoring and store modules load at startup. Local installation and a later human manual restart are separate facts; no trader is started or restarted by publication.
summary: Avoid repeated full model-payload decoding in independent outcome scoring
